title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | FUT Developer Launch Update
summary: Hear directly from the FUT development team following the launch of EA SPORTS FC™ 27, covering early feedback and what we’re working on.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: Welcome to our first FUT Developer Notes for FC 27. It’s been great to see you building your squads, trying out the new ways to play and progress, and sharing plenty of feedback along the way.

sections.title: What We’re Seeing
sections.summary: It’s been exciting for us to see how players are taking to The Gallery. We’re seeing players share strategies, find creative ways to earn Set Grades, and get the Hall of FUT players they want most.

sections.title: What We’re Hearing From You
sections.summary: One of the biggest conversations we’re following right now is around Evolutions and the broader pace of squad upgrades. We know how important Evolutions are for keeping the players you care about in your squad.

sections.title: What We’re Working On
